questions.text: Who are the users, and which distinct roles exist?
What problem, goal or job does each role have today, and how is it handled now?
What is the business objective and how will success be measured?
Which statements above are evidence and which are assumptions?
What are the riskiest assumptions and how will they be tested?
What constraints apply: budget, deadline, client environment, regulation?
Which single end-to-end journey must the first release complete?
Which activities and tasks are in the first release?
Which features are explicitly excluded from the first release?
What content or data must each task show or collect, and why is each field needed?
Which regulatory, contractual or other non-negotiable requirements apply?
How do users sign in: method, identity provider, password reset and session lifetime?
What can each role see and do, as a role-to-capability matrix?
How are users and roles created, changed and removed?
Is the product multi-tenant, and what separates one tenant's data from another's?
What happens on sign-out, session expiry and a denied action?
What are the main journeys for each role, step by step?
What is the concrete example (given, when, then) for each step that changes data?
What are the failure, empty, permission-denied and cancel branches of each journey?
Which steps are irreversible or destructive?
What are the top-level destinations and their labels?
Which destinations does each role reach, as a role-to-destination matrix?
Which navigation pattern is used on wide and narrow screens?
What is the first screen after sign-in for each role?
How do deep links, refresh and browser back behave?
What is the complete screen inventory, each mapped to a journey step?
What does each screen show, in priority order?
For each table: identifier column, column order, sorting, filters, row and batch actions?
For each form: fields, which are required, validation rules, when validation runs and the error messages?
What are the loading, empty, error, unauthorized and forbidden states of each screen?
Where does each action lead and which backend operation does it call?
Which actions need confirmation, and is undo possible instead?
Has the product owner approved the clickable prototype, and where are the approved screenshots stored?
Which design system or component library is adopted or adapted?
What are the spacing base unit, type scale and colour tokens?
Do text and control colour pairs meet the chosen contrast level?
Which browsers, devices, languages and text directions are supported?
What accessibility level applies and who performs the manual evaluation?
Which module owns each entity, and who writes and reads it?
What are the entities, relationships and cardinalities?
For each relationship, is the child part of the parent or independent, and what happens on delete?
What are the attributes of each entity, with type class, optionality and the meaning of an absent value?
What are the natural keys and their uniqueness scope, including case rules?
Which value sets are closed and who may change them?
How are money, time zones and rounding handled?
What history is kept: current state only, audit trail, soft delete?
Which columns hold personal or sensitive data, and what are the retention and erasure rules?
What is the tenancy model and how is isolation enforced?
What are the main read and write queries and their expected volumes?
Which language and framework are used, and why if not the default?
How many deployable units are there, and what justifies each beyond the first?
What are the module boundaries and which rules are enforced by checks?
What is the API contract: operations, errors, pagination and compatibility?
Which external systems are integrated, and how do timeouts and failures behave?
How are business rules organised, and what justifies anything beyond simple service functions?
What are the measurable performance and availability targets and their environment?
What are the main abuse cases and the mitigation for each?
Which personal data is processed, for what purpose and on what recorded basis?
Which AI or model providers receive project content, and what do they receive?
Which test cases are mandatory for the first release?
Where does the product run and who authorizes a release?
What are the recovery objectives and the backup and restore plan?
What is monitored and who responds to an alert?
What is the first task list, in order, with dependencies?
Which decisions remain open, who owns each and by when?
